CustomField.description: Maps the current stage to its forecast category for reporting purposes
CustomField.formula: IF(OR( TEXT(StageName)="Exploratory Call", TEXT(StageName)="Needs Analysis", TEXT(StageName)="Solution Pending", TEXT(StageName)="Demo Awaited", TEXT(StageName)="Demo Scheduled", TEXT(StageName)="Demo Completed", TEXT(StageName)="Solution Proposed", TEXT(StageName)="Alternate Solution Pending", TEXT(StageName)="Alternate Solution Proposed", TEXT(StageName)="Trainer Evaluation", TEXT(StageName)="Trial Accounts Given" ), "Pipeline", IF(OR( TEXT(StageName)="Negotiation / Review", TEXT(StageName)="Final Approval pending" ), "Best Case", IF(OR( TEXT(StageName)="Closed Won", TEXT(StageName)="Delivery Pending", TEXT(StageName)="Delivery In Progress", TEXT(StageName)="Delivery Completed" ), "Commit", IF(OR( TEXT(StageName)="Invoiced", TEXT(StageName)="Invoiced - Delivery Pending", TEXT(StageName)="Invoiced - Delivery in Progress", TEXT(StageName)="Overdue", TEXT(StageName)="Collected" ), "Closed", IF(OR( TEXT(StageName)="Campaign", TEXT(StageName)="Closed Lost", TEXT(StageName)="Closed-Lost to Competition", TEXT(StageName)="Cold", TEXT(StageName)="Deferred", TEXT(StageName)="Solution Declined", TEXT(StageName)="Training Cancelled" ), "Omitted", "Unknown")))))
CustomField.label: Forecast Category at Transition
